messages:
Oncall-Bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Autoscaler has hit max_node_count on gpu-pool-east-1. Active queue length: ~12,300. Throttling engaged (503/429s rising). Pager sent to #incidents and oncall. thread_ts=1998765432
Maya R: I’m on it. Observing spike in LLM generation queue. Any recent deploys?
Leo C: No deploys in last 30m. Metrics: token throughput flat, enqueuing rate doubled ~10:16 UTC. Autoscaler refused to add nodes due to policy max_nodes=64.
Elena P: Confirmed — scale attempts return "reached upper bound" from scaler controller: 
```
E0421 10:16:09 scaler.go:312] desired=72, max_allowed=64, action=deny
```
Maya R: Who can authorize a temporary cap bump? We need at least +20 nodes to drain.
Nora V: Infra runbook says incident handoff to infra-sre leads for manual override. @Elena P can you approve?
Elena P: I approve a temporary bump to 84 nodes for 2 hours. Post the change and add reason referencing incident 1998765432.
Sam T: I can run the change — will need infra auth. Leaving a note: do not change autoscale policy; only increase pool ceiling.
Maya R: ETA to run? Also call out customers affected so CS can message if needed.
InfraBot: Action required: manual_capacity_bump request created (ticket #IC-8345). Required approvers: [Elena P].
Elena P: Approved in ticket. Go ahead. :thumbsup:
Sam T: Running command now:
```
infractl capacity bump --pool gpu-pool-east-1 --new-ceiling 84 --duration 2h --reason "incident 1998765432: burst spike" 
```
Sam T: Command submitted. Waiting for infractl confirmation.
InfraBot: infractl: capacity bump in progress. request_id=rb-IC-8345. Allocating nodes via cloud API.
InfraBot: alloc_event: started provisioning 20 instances (g4dn.xlarge) in us-east-1. estimated 8-12m.
Maya R: Noted. Queues are prioritized by customer tier; premium queues still suffering but partial success expected once nodes come up.
Leo C: Parallel mitigation: enabling prefix KV cache for high-frequency prompt families to reduce token generation load. Patching runtime config: 
```
PATCH /runtime/configs/kv_cache
{ "enabled": true, "cache_ttl": 600 }
```
Maya R: Good — that should shave some work off while nodes spin.
InfraBot: Provisioning completed. new_node_count=84. Scaler controller updated.
Sam T: Verified via infractl and k8s: node count reflected in pool, pods scheduled. Running drain check.
InfraBot: Node join logs: 
```
node-198 added to gpu-pool-east-1
pods_pending -> 0
queue_depth -> 3,200 (down from 12,300)
```
Maya R: Queue dropped to ~3.2k, throttling reduced. Error rate on hosted API (east) dropped from 7.8% to 1.1% over 4m.
Nora V: CS: Customers A, C, and D reported elevated latencies/429s. Nora will prepare a status update once we have stabilization note.
Elena P: Please capture timeline and why autoscaler didn't proactively request higher maxima. We need a post-incident action item.
Leo C: Logging shows scale decisions capped by policy; desired > max_nodes because of sudden surge in enqueue. We'll add autoscale margin +20% to high-priority pools. Action: create RFC.
Maya R: On-call handoff in 1h. Sam, can you stay for handoff?
Sam T: I can stay. Handoff notes: manual bump made, nodes healthy, runtime cache enabled, customers affected listed in IC-8345.
Maya R: I'm going to update the incident channel and page next shift with summary. Any lingering customer errors?
Nora V: Minor 503s for low-tier customers — trending down. I'll post a short blurb for statuspage once confirmed 15m stable.
InfraBot: Stabilization check: 15m rolling window shows error_rate < 2% and queue < 4k.
Maya R: Good. Handoff to Leo in 55m. Please keep notification on if error_rate creeps.
Leo C: Will take on after Maya. Action items noted: (1) Postmortem draft, (2) Adjust autoscale margins, (3) Explore emergency quick-bump runbook to reduce manual approvals for short windows.
Sam T: One small note: we should add telemetry to alert when desired_nodes > 0.9*max_nodes so we can preempt.
Maya R: Agreed. Final: manual bump executed, capacity restored, customer impact limited/mitigated. Tagging support/CS for followups. :white_check_mark:
Oncall-Bot: Incident 1998765432 — status: mitigated. Next step: assign postmortem owner and set severity to Sev3 for follow-up.
Maya R: I'll own the postmortem. Leaving final note and handoff to Leo in 50m. Thanks team. :pray:
